{{Infobox auto}}
'''Cooked pufferfish''' is a [[food]] item made by cooking a [[pufferfish]] or a [[Freshwater Puffer|freshwater puffer]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and grants [[Conduit Power]] for 30 seconds.

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking ===
Cooking takes 5 seconds in an [[Oven]] or on [[Kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_pufferfish.json}}</ref>
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Eating it gives a hidden Regeneration III for 48 ticks, which heals {{Hp|4}}, and Conduit Power for 600 ticks (0:30). Unlike raw pufferfish, it doesn't poison.
Cooked pufferfish is a cooked cod item underneath, so recipes that take [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]] also accept it.
